d: On the 24th of November, Russian Tu-160 nuclear-capable bombers, flanked by Su-35 fighter jets carried out a 10-hour-long air dominance patrol over the Sea of Japan. The Russian aircraft flew towards South Korea and violated South Korea's Air Defence Identification Zone. They were just a few kilometres away from the Ulleung island before they turned around after South Korea scrambled its US-made F-15 fighter jets. Russia's defence ministry has released footage of the entire sortie revealing that a Su-57 stealth fighter jet was also part of the air dominance patrol. The Russian war machines…
